A '''cold-weld arrestor''' was part of the [[S-foil servo actuator/Legends|S-Foil Servo Actuator]] system aboard a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. Once the [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] were deployed, the arrestors were used to lock the servos in place.<ref name="SWS" />
